evidence_spans: Here, we propose a highly efficient DFT-based method aided by a specially designed machine learning potential.

question_variants.resolution_summary: Based on the formula (2RMSE/ c ) 2 provided, increasing the RMSE will increase the required number of snapshots quadratically.
